lang: Hebrew (English summary p. 217 included in the PDF)
location_note: 'En Ya'al, Jerusalem, June 1994, Areas A-C. The printed references (Area B: NIG 17775/77195, OIG 12775/17195; Areas A and C similar) do not fit either grid for Jerusalem and are unusable; placed by the title name Jerusalem (Z4) (choice C6).
notes: Area B: rock-cut burial complex with courtyard, framed entrance, quadrangular chamber, standing pit, coarse unfinished kokhim on one side and a repository. Plan of Second Temple type; used then (cleared later), again in the mid-1st-2nd c. CE (glass) and in the 4th-7th c. CE; plundered perhaps in the Abbasid period. Areas A and C: rock cuttings without datable finds.
